title: You Trust Butterflies in Your Stomach, Yet a Scary Bridge Fakes Falling in Love
description:
You think your heart knows the difference between terror and love! Yet a swaying bridge tricked men into mistaking fear for romance! This is the true story of Dutton and Aron's Capilano Bridge Experiment. Here is what went wrong with trusting butterflies.
